description:
Export the project as an RML mapping document (RML-Core + RML-IO, namespace http://w3id.org/rml/):
one rml:TriplesMap per Type, an rml:logicalSource per source file or table, a subject template from
the identifier element, one rml:predicateObjectMap per Element, and joins (rml:parentTriplesMap +
rml:joinCondition) for type references. Run the result in an RML engine (RMLMapper, morph-KGC,
SDM-RDFizer) to build a knowledge graph from your data.

Give sourceKind to bind it to real data (csv | json | xml | sql | sql-query); omit it for a
skeleton with placeholder sources. The document's first line states its fidelity: RUNNABLE,
TEMPLATE or SKELETON.

Class and predicate IRIs come from each Type's and Element's mapsTo binding. Where a term is not
bound, the IRI is minted from its name and reported as '# lossiness:' — a mapping built on minted
IRIs produces a graph that joins to nothing, so bind the terms (bind_ontology_term) before
publishing the output.

baseIri.description: Namespace subject IRIs are built under, e.g. https://data.example.gov/id

sourceForm.description: shorthand (default) is what RML engines accept today; rml-io is the newer structured source form

sourceTemplate.description: Path or table per type, with {type} substituted, e.g. data/{type}.csv

name: export_rml
title: Export RML mapping (Turtle)
